missing: A direct, tested pick of mini projectors that actually work with an iPhone: which support AirPlay or wired Lightning/USB-C mirroring, which block Netflix/Disney+ due to HDCP/DRM, and current prices for each.
why: Half the results are off-target (webcams, cameras, mics, a film-club essay, a 4K home-cinema preview) and Wirecutter came through unreadable. TechRadar and RTINGS both have tested portable-projector roundups in the results, but they answer the neighbouring "best portable projector" question and neither addresses the iPhone constraint (AirPlay, wired mirroring, HDCP). The pages that do target "for phone/iPhone" are affiliate listicles pushing no-name Amazon units with unverifiable testing. A page that tests iPhone connectivity and DRM playback per model with current prices would compete with the two major tested roundups but fill a gap they leave.
